milestones.title: Decision
milestones.desc: Team by team, against the baseline

footnote: Source: Autonomy et al., UK pilot report, Feb 2023, for two months of preparation before a six-month trial. The baseline is November and December
notes: The timeline. This memo goes out in October. Preparation starts on November 1: HR runs the first staff survey, and each department pulls its November and December figures for customer response, output, overtime and contractor spend as the baseline. Rotas, stop-doing lists and cover plans are due by November 30. The trial starts on Monday, January 4, 2027. On March 31 we review it at the midpoint with a second survey, and rotas can change. It ends on June 30 with a third survey. By July 31 we decide, department by department, against the baseline. In weeks with a public holiday, the holiday is the short day and there is no extra day off.
